description: The Capital gains tab: this tax year's disposals in general investment and crypto accounts, matched in HMRC's order (same day, 30 days, the pool), the gain after losses, what's left of the annual exempt amount, and whether it's likely to need reporting. Use for 'how much of my CGT allowance have I used', 'do I need to report my gains', 'what did I make on sales this year'. Accepts a tax year.

taxYear.description: The starting year, e.g. "2026" for 2026/27. Defaults to this tax year.

name: get_capital_gains
title: Capital gains this tax year
